remainingIssues.detail: Present progressive can express a future arrangement. Not yet started does not alone make What colour are you painting the fence? or Where are they putting the chairs? current-action questions. The scope explicitly requires be going to, making rejection valid for this exercise; feedback should cite that form restriction instead of claiming progressive necessarily asks about action happening now.
